text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Say, Trainer. I haven't beenfeelin' too great lately.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I don't have a fever, and I'm not<n>hurting anywhere,
but my body's<n>been weighin' me down...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Think I'm comin' down with<n>something? I make
sure to eat my<n>veggies and all...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle orders herself a<n>hamburger and a large
plate of fries<n>while we talk.
choice_data_list: It's because of what you're eating!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
What?! But I've been eatin' lots of<n>healthy
veggies! I even snack on<n>potato chips at night!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
You can't fool me, Trainer! I know a<n>joke when I
hear one...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Wait... Are ya bein' serious? Is it<n>really that bad?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I review her eating habits and<n>incorporate some
healthier<n>alternatives.
